name: rulekit
description: Clinical-trial eligibility criteria as versioned, tested, conflict-checked YAML rules — deterministic engine, feasibility workbench, and an LLM facts compiler where humans confirm and only the engine decides

scripts.dogfood: tsx src/cli/index.ts check rules/trials/demo-hf-001/ruleset@1.0.0.yaml --fact-model packs/trials/fact-model.yaml && tsx src/cli/index.ts test rules/trials/demo-hf-001 --fact-model packs/trials/fact-model.yaml --corpus fixtures/patients && tsx src/cli/index.ts check rules/trials/commander-hf/ruleset.yaml --fact-model packs/trials/fact-model.yaml && tsx src/cli/index.ts test rules/trials/commander-hf --fact-model packs/trials/fact-model.yaml
scripts.corpus:build: npm run corpus:fetch && npm run corpus:flatten && npm run corpus:mess && npm run corpus:normalize
scripts.eval: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.yaml
